model_type: sklearn Pipeline: ColumnTransformer(log1p on the listed columns, others passed through) -> ExtraTreesRegressor

target.name: avg_sales_index
target.definition: mean of the daily sales index over 2026-09-01..2026-09-10 (10 days). Daily index = branch sales after discounts / highest single-day sales of any included branch x 100 (iiko).
target.interpretation: early-September 2026 performance of an established branch; predictions are not clipped to 1-100

preprocessing.missing_values: none in training; every feature must be present at prediction time
preprocessing.column_order: pass a DataFrame with the columns in `features`

not_used.accessibility: no signal on its own; adding it raised spatial MAE (ExtraTrees 7.989 -> 8.148)
not_used.network_127: same features against the 127 labelled branches only; robustness check, not combined

poi_500m.reason: final check: removing them changed spatial MAE 7.989 -> 7.594 and 5-seed random CV 8.696 -> 8.699 (selected on 2026-10-12 at 7.93 -> 7.64 and 8.73 -> 8.71, before universities_2km was removed)

not_used.universities_2km: removed 2026-10-13: counts amenity=university|college OSM objects, which are mostly vocational colleges, lyceums, unnamed objects and campus parts, not universities; not replaced

limitations: The supplied data contain only two Safia Mini branches, both with relatively low sales indices. This was insufficient to estimate a robust format effect, so branch format was excluded from the final model.

validation.unit: one branch (the 1,270 branch-day rows are never split)

spatial.design: leave-one-group-out over 5 groups: 4 k-means sectors of the 104 branches within 25 km of central Tashkent + all 23 branches farther out

standard_5seeds.design: KFold(5) repeated with shuffle seeds 0-4 (25 folds)

validation.metrics_note: MAE primary; mean and std (ddof=1) over folds. The final model was chosen on these same folds from about 40 candidates, so the estimates are slightly optimistic.

data_snapshots.stat_uz: stat.uz district tables, 2026 values (growth vs 2025), downloaded 2026-10-11

scoring_a_new_site: compute the same 22 features at the site's lat/lon: sofia_task.osm_poi_features.osm_poi_features, sofia_task.network_features.public_network_features against all 160 official stores (nothing excluded), and the stat.uz district of the site (as in scripts/build_branch_demographics.py)
